description: Minimum test count per tier. A suite that shrinks without explanation is a silently disabled suite — a broken include glob drops the unit tier from 1024 tests to 3 and every other gate still passes, because total > 0, failed === 0 and success === true.
howToRaise: Raise a floor in the same commit that adds the tests. Lowering one is also a reviewable diff — state why in the commit message.
establishedBy: PR CI run 19 (run id 30431556718), artifacts `evidence-unit-coverage` / `evidence-security-matrix` / `evidence-integration-tests`, files `test-totals-unit.json`, `test-totals-database.json`, `test-totals-backend.json`, at feature head 8d7bfff09cf914e00ff5ff4587341ece261185c3, started 2026-07-29T07:24:48Z, GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest. All three tiers now carry a hosted measurement; none is a local or carried-over figure.
enforcementNote: Only `minTests` is enforced — summarise-vitest.mjs fails a tier that runs fewer. `measured` is provenance: it records what the named run actually observed, so a later reader can see how much headroom a floor had when it was set.

unit.note: Raised from 1000 to 1050. Run 19 measured 1082 on a hosted runner, replacing the local 1024 that established the old floor. The floor keeps roughly 30 tests of headroom for ordinary churn while no longer sitting 82 below the real count, where it could have absorbed an entire deleted test file without complaint.

web.note: Established on PR #214 (P1-27 Frontend) by GitHub-hosted run 31311573993, job `Web quality / web-quality`, artifact `evidence-web-quality`, file `test-totals-web.json`, at head cc77255d7343a6691077b4574d4491e05615ed95: 1216 tests across 65 test files, 0 failed, 0 skipped, 0 todo. That run set the original floor of 1180. RAISED across this remediation to 1509, then 1433, then 1473 during the canonical-blocker remediation on the same PR, which added the executed-write suite, the route permission-binding suite, the profile accessibility suite, the plate-section suite and the corrected API-contract cases, taking the tier to 70 files and 1586 executed cases (the defect wave that followed added the 422 field-error path, the CSP sink cases and the const-arrow completeness cases). The raise was forced rather than chosen: 1180 sat BELOW the 1264 cases the tree now declares on disk, and a floor beneath cases that physically exist is not a guard. See measurementProvenance — the 1467 is a LOCAL figure and is replaced by the hosted measurement P1-27-QA-005 takes against the final candidate.
web.whatTheHeadroomGuarantees: THE FLOOR DETECTS ANY NET LOSS OF MORE THAN 77 EXECUTED TESTS. That is measured (1586) minus the floor (1509), and it is stated as the bound it actually is rather than as a slogan about deleting a file. The largest web test file declares 77 cases, so the headroom equals it exactly: deleting the largest file trips the floor. The two goals remain in tension — headroom must exceed 0 or the floor is a transcript of its own run, and must not exceed the largest file for the deletion guarantee to hold — and this value satisfies both for this tree.
web.measuredFilesNote: `measuredFiles` is 65 — physical test files. It read 379 until this correction, because `summarise()` populated it from `numTotalTestSuites`, which vitest sets to every `describe` block recursively. The suite count is retained as `measuredSuites` so a reader comparing this against an older artifact can see which number changed meaning rather than assuming the tier shrank by 314 files.
web.measurementProvenance: LOCAL, PENDING A HOSTED RE-MEASUREMENT. Every earlier figure in this file was taken from a named hosted run, and this one is not: it was measured in the integration checkout while the remediation branch was still being assembled. It is recorded as local rather than dressed up as hosted, because a provenance field that lies is worse than one that admits what it is. P1-27-QA-005 takes the binding measurement against the final candidate on GitHub-hosted CI, and that run replaces measured, measuredFiles and measuredSuites here. measuredSuites is null rather than a stale 379 — the old value described a different tree and was itself the subject of a correction (it had been populated from numTotalTestSuites, which counts every describe block).

unitFloorCaveat: The unit floor is deliberately NOT set to the measurement of the run that carries this commit. This change adds twenty tests — eight in tests/ci/dependency-path-proof.test.ts (AR-49), four in the workflow-security rule-registry suite (AR-50), four in tests/ci/baseline-integrity.test.ts covering the baselines established here, and four in tests/ci/documented-counts.test.ts (AR-51) — so the final head measures 1102, not the 1082 recorded above. Setting 1102 as the floor would make it a transcript of the last run rather than a guard, and every future commit would have to move it. 1050 is the guard; 1082 stays as the provenance of run 19. Note that this sentence is itself the kind of hand-written count AR-51 was about, which is why the floor and the provenance figure — the two values anything actually reads — are measured rather than narrated.
